title: Install Skills: tstack and pstack
description: Script to clone and install tstack skills (file-pr, babysit-pr, leaving-pr-comments) and pstack skills (in-your-own-words, how, architect, blast-radius, principle-prove-it-works) at pinned commits.

steps.description: Tstack: TSTACK commit hash, clone t3dotgg/tstack, checkout commit, copy three skills to .agents/skills/.
Separator: blank line between tstack and pstack sections.
Pstack: PSTACK commit hash, clone cursor/plugins with filter, sparse-checkout pstack, checkout commit, copy five skills, copy LICENSE.
